n614870c1c1.summary: Taiwan's 'financial trio' recorded combined pre-tax earnings of NT$904.245 billion in the first six months, up 139.14% year on year. The figure is a record for the same period.
n614870c1c1.why: Taiwan's largest financial holding groups span banking, insurance and securities, and their earnings are a bellwether for the island's financial sector.

nfc9fc83bb8.why: Local tax burdens affect business operating costs and property values in the city, which matters for companies and investors in Bulgaria.

nb74b3d9773.summary: A SI-UGS study says living as a young person in Abruzzo costs more than three years ago. Student room rents in Teramo rose from 200 to 300 euros a month, up 50% since 2023.
nb74b3d9773.why: Housing and transport costs for young workers and students affect household spending and regional labour supply. Rising rents also feed into local property and consumer demand.

n3e9cb6062f.summary: The National Bank of Ukraine changed its key policy rate and worsened its inflation forecast, with inflation expected to accelerate in the second half of the year.
n3e9cb6062f.why: The National Bank of Ukraine sets the country's key policy rate, which shapes lending costs, the hryvnia, and inflation expectations.

n3da0794338.headline: Rubio’s bypass plan: Can the world escape the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint?
n3da0794338.summary: Experts warn that Marco Rubio's plan to bypass the Strait of Hormuz is constrained by pipeline capacity limits and serious threats in the Red Sea. The plan's viability is in doubt.
n3da0794338.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so alternative export routes affect energy security and prices. Pipeline capacity determines how much crude can be rerouted.

n827bcb5b56.headline: Australia records biggest-ever surge in EV sales
n827bcb5b56.summary: Nearly one in every two new vehicles sold in Australia across April, May and June was either electric or hybrid. The surge is the biggest on record.
n827bcb5b56.why: Electric and hybrid vehicle adoption shapes demand for car makers, battery supply chains and charging infrastructure.

n925a74eb63.headline: Trump says fresh Iran talks set to begin after major strikes called off
n925a74eb63.summary: Trump said fresh Iran talks are set to begin after major strikes were called off, as Iranian mediators work to revive June's memorandum of understanding.
n925a74eb63.why: US-Iran tensions affect oil supply risk, shipping routes and global risk sentiment.
n925a74eb63.why_moved: Calling off major strikes and starting new talks reduces the near-term risk of conflict disrupting oil supply.

n38ded1aa74.headline: Meme traders fuelled AI rout, says Blue Whale's Stephen Yiu
n38ded1aa74.summary: Stephen Yiu of Blue Whale said selling among small investors spooked by fears over AI spending hit his fund. Blue Whale counts Peter Hargreaves among its main backers.
n38ded1aa74.why: Blue Whale is an investment fund whose performance reflects its equity holdings. Retail-driven selling can amplify volatility in high-profile technology stocks.
n38ded1aa74.why_moved: Small investors reportedly sold stocks after becoming worried about AI spending, and that selling hit the fund's holdings.

nbed58b36a6.headline: Iraq-Turkey pipeline pact renewed
nbed58b36a6.summary: Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said an agreement extending the operational use of the Iraq-Turkey oil pipeline for one year has been signed. It replaces the previous framework.
nbed58b36a6.why: The Iraq-Turkey pipeline is a key export route for Iraqi crude to Mediterranean ports, so its continuity affects regional oil flows.

n82e37ca2a7.headline: Iran’s allied militias prove their value in Tehran’s widening war
n82e37ca2a7.summary: Armed groups loyal to Tehran appear to be recovering across the Middle East after three difficult years, reinforcing Iran's leverage in its war with the United States and Israel.
n82e37ca2a7.why: Iran's regional proxy network shapes security risk for shipping, energy infrastructure and Gulf markets, which investors price into oil and regional assets.

n151233788e.headline: FPIs reverse 4-month selling  trend with Rs 20,200 cr inflow in July
n151233788e.summary: Foreign portfolio investors pumped Rs 20,200 crore into Indian equities in July, reversing four straight months of selling, aided by valuations and improving corporate earnings.
n151233788e.why: Foreign portfolio flows into India are a key driver of liquidity and valuations in the country's stock market.

nfb6d39c006.headline: PHL digital economy makes up 2.5% of GDP — ADB
nfb6d39c006.summary: The Philippine digital economy equals 2.5% of gross domestic product, according to the Asian Development Bank, lagging the region's leading economies.
nfb6d39c006.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender that publishes regional economic assessments used by investors to gauge growth prospects.

nf45ba17d8f.headline: IRDAI mandates approval at every key ownership threshold in insurers as sector opens up
nf45ba17d8f.summary: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India introduced stricter ownership approval rules, requiring approval at every key ownership threshold. The move comes amid rising investor interest and sector consolidation.
nf45ba17d8f.why: The insurance regulator oversees who can own and control insurers, which affects capital inflows and consolidation in the sector.

ne5e9ff920b.headline: BYD’s July sales rise on strong exports, but meeting its annual target remains a challenge
ne5e9ff920b.summary: BYD's July sales rose on strong exports, but the company needs to sell about 530,000 cars a month for the rest of 2026 to reach its annual goal.
ne5e9ff920b.why: BYD is China's largest electric vehicle maker, and its volumes and export growth shape global EV market share and competition.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: Strong July exports support sales, but the annual target requires a sharp monthly sales increase.

n38322f4d4f.summary: The UK Chancellor has vowed to protect motorists from petrol pump prices. Prices have continued to rise as hostilities between the US and Iran continue.
n38322f4d4f.why: Fuel prices feed directly into UK inflation and household budgets, so government measures on fuel costs matter for rates and consumer spending expectations.

n4d7e210422.headline: Elon Musk's wealth plunges by over $600 billion as SpaceX, Tesla shares tumble
n4d7e210422.summary: Elon Musk's personal fortune has shrunk by more than $600 billion in just over a month. The decline followed a sharp fall in the shares of SpaceX and Tesla.
n4d7e210422.why: Tesla is a listed electric vehicle and energy company, and Musk's holdings in Tesla and SpaceX make his wealth sensitive to both stocks.

impacts.why: Tesla shares declined sharply, contributing to the fall in Musk's fortune.

naf41a5aa54.headline: New market timings from Monday; F&O segment to remain open till 3:40pm
naf41a5aa54.summary: New market timings from August 3 extend F&O segment trading until 3:40 pm and introduce a new Closing Auction Session. The changes apply to Indian derivatives trading.
naf41a5aa54.why: Trading hours and closing mechanisms set when investors can execute derivatives trades and how closing prices are formed on Indian exchanges.

n9c0e46b791.headline: The shift to digital tax: Are Philippine businesses ready?
n9c0e46b791.summary: The Bureau of Internal Revenue is accelerating its digital transformation through electronic invoicing and eventually electronic sales reporting requirements for taxpayers.
n9c0e46b791.why: The Bureau of Internal Revenue is the Philippines' tax authority, and its reporting rules directly affect corporate compliance costs.

n4f1a84d3b6.headline: Australia's fuel discount has ended, what does it mean for petrol prices?
n4f1a84d3b6.summary: Australia's federal government has wound up its fuel excise discount, and motorists are bracing for higher prices at the pump. The change takes the discount off fuel.
n4f1a84d3b6.why: Fuel excise is a tax on petrol and diesel, and changes to it pass through to pump prices, transport costs and inflation.

nf5b6b97506.headline: US will hold off on Iran attacks in hope of quick deal
nf5b6b97506.summary: Donald Trump said Mideast allies have reached the parameters of a deal to end the Iran war, and the US will hold off on attacks in hope of a quick agreement.
nf5b6b97506.why: The Iran conflict affects Gulf oil supply routes and regional risk, which feed into crude prices and global risk sentiment.

n42828a3328.headline: Tomato, cooking oil prices rise in mid-July, but pork, rice prices fall
n42828a3328.summary: The Philippine Statistics Authority said tomato and cooking oil prices rose month on month in mid-July, while pork and rice prices fell.
n42828a3328.why: Food price movements feed into the Philippines' consumer inflation, which influences central bank policy and the peso.

n629d4c1fdc.headline: Trump Halts Iran Strike Plans, Bets on Fast Diplomatic Deal
n629d4c1fdc.summary: US President Donald Trump said he has called off planned military strikes against Iran and is instead pursuing a swift diplomatic deal.
n629d4c1fdc.why: US military action against Iran could disrupt Gulf oil flows, so changes in strike plans influence oil prices and risk sentiment.
n629d4c1fdc.why_moved: Calling off planned strikes and pursuing a fast deal lowers the risk of wider conflict in the Gulf, which reduces the risk premium in oil.

n6f83a9cd9e.headline: Trump says he will hold off on fresh Iran attack in hope of a quick deal on nuclear threat, Hormuz
n6f83a9cd9e.summary: Trump said he will hold off on a fresh attack on Iran in hope of a quick deal on the nuclear threat and the Strait of Hormuz. Middle Eastern nations asked for time to complete an agreement on reopening the strait.
n6f83a9cd9e.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there directly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
n6f83a9cd9e.why_moved: Trump's pause on a fresh attack and the talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz reduce near-term risk to Gulf oil flows.

n19bf198927.headline: PCCI says long-term reforms must follow removal of system loss from power bills
n19bf198927.summary: The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry supports removing the system loss charge from power bills. It said long-term reforms must follow the change.
n19bf198927.why: Electricity charges in the Philippines affect industrial costs and competitiveness, and utility regulation shapes power sector investment.

nfac20b5d6a.headline: Oil slumps as Trump holds off Iran attack, says talks to resume
nfac20b5d6a.summary: Brent crude for October fell as much as 7.3% in early Asian trade after Trump held off an Iran attack and said talks would resume.
nfac20b5d6a.why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, so shifts in Middle East tensions quickly feed into prices.
nfac20b5d6a.why_moved: Holding off an attack and resuming talks lowers the perceived risk of disruption to Gulf oil supply.

n8c53619eff.headline: Tobacco, vape firms ordered to register brands with BIR
n8c53619eff.summary: The Bureau of Internal Revenue has given tobacco and vapor-product manufacturers, importers and exporters six months to register their brands.
n8c53619eff.why: The Bureau of Internal Revenue is the Philippines' tax authority, and its brand registration rules affect excise tax collection on tobacco and vape products.

na699088363.headline: Lodha Developers to monetise 150 acres at data centre park in MMR for ₹10,000 cr: MD
na699088363.summary: Lodha Developers plans to monetise 150 acres in its data centre park in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region for ₹10,000 crore. The company is targeting 20% annual net profit growth.
na699088363.why: Lodha Developers is a major Indian real estate developer, and data centre land monetisation is tied to growing demand for digital infrastructure.

n5409be8b5b.headline: Maruti Suzuki clocks record monthly  production in July at 2,48,845 units
n5409be8b5b.summary: India's largest automaker Maruti Suzuki produced 248,845 units in July, a 33 percent rise from a year earlier. It is the company's highest monthly output on record.
n5409be8b5b.why: Maruti Suzuki is India's largest passenger carmaker, so its output is a key indicator of domestic auto demand.

na68ae0c92e.summary: Two Japanese officials told Reuters that Finance Minister Katayama will disclose that Tokyo and Washington engaged in a unified currency market operation to counter the yen's steep fall to its weakest against the dollar.
na68ae0c92e.why: Coordinated intervention by Japan and the US signals official resistance to yen weakness, which directly affects USD/JPY trading and Japanese asset returns for foreign investors.

n01ed7277f6.summary: TOBB President Rifat Hisarcıklıoğlu announced the reactivation of the low-interest, long-term TOBB Breath Loan, backed by a KGF guarantee, after businesses faced financing problems.

neb06a57de5.headline: Korea's birth rebound offers hope, but demographic challenges remain
neb06a57de5.summary: South Korea's fertility rate is extending a tentative recovery from its record low, raising hopes the annual figure could top 0.9 for the first time in seven years.
neb06a57de5.why: Fertility trends shape long-term labour supply, consumer demand and pension sustainability. South Korea has one of the world's lowest birth rates.

n2528620f9f.headline: India’s Q1 GDP may clock 7 pc growth as macro conditions improve amid global tensions: Report
n2528620f9f.summary: A new report indicates India's Q1 FY27 GDP may grow 7.0% as macroeconomic conditions improve despite global tensions. The figure is a preliminary estimate.
n2528620f9f.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic activity and shapes expectations for corporate earnings and central bank policy in India.

nd1657ae367.headline: RBI MPC Meeting Begins August 3, Repo Rate Likely To Stay At 5.25% As Focus Shifts To Liquidity Management
nd1657ae367.summary: The RBI's MPC meeting starts August 3 and the repo rate is likely to stay at 5.25%, with liquidity management, inflation risks and growth concerns in focus.
nd1657ae367.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the repo rate that anchors borrowing costs across India's banking system and bond market.

n4ee4b2367d.headline: Zepto Plans Pre-IPO Private Placement, Aims To Strengthen Balance Sheet Before ₹8,010 Crore Public Issue
n4ee4b2367d.summary: Quick-commerce firm Zepto will raise fresh funds through a pre-IPO private placement to strengthen its balance sheet. It has zero debt and plans an Rs 8,010 crore public issue.
n4ee4b2367d.why: Zepto is an Indian quick-commerce company, and its listing would be a major test for consumer internet valuations in India.

n998cab0308.headline: FII Outflows Ease Sharply In July, Strong DII Buying And Better Sentiment Support Indian Markets
n998cab0308.summary: Foreign institutional investor outflows from Indian equities fell to a 2026 low of Rs 5,780 crore in July. Strong domestic institutional buying continued to support markets.
n998cab0308.why: Foreign institutional investors are a key source of flows for Indian equities, while domestic institutions such as mutual funds increasingly offset that selling. Flow data is closely tracked for market direction.

n3411b71c9b.headline: CPC Holds Fuel Prices Steady for August, Bringing Relief to Motorists and Businesses
n3411b71c9b.summary: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has announced that fuel prices across Sri Lanka will remain unchanged for August. The decision offers relief to motorists and businesses.
n3411b71c9b.why: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation is Sri Lanka's state-owned fuel importer and distributor, and its monthly pricing affects inflation and transport costs. Fuel price decisions influence household and business budgets.

n2cab4559a1.headline: What does the Fitch decision mean for Romania? Iancu Guda: “Implementation of reforms is inevitable”
n2cab4559a1.summary: Fitch has kept Romania's rating in the recommended investment categories. Analyst Iancu Guda said public debt and political risk remain the main challenges, and that reform implementation is inevitable.
n2cab4559a1.why: Fitch Ratings is one of the three major global credit rating agencies. Its sovereign rating decisions shape borrowing costs and investor access to a country's debt.

nadf4f5459f.summary: A report examines how much money Ukrainians hold in bank accounts and which currency they prefer, with dollars and euros compared.
nadf4f5459f.why: Currency preferences in household deposits indicate confidence in the local currency and affect the funding base of Ukrainian banks. Deposit flows matter for lenders and monetary policy.

n1e1ee6d98c.why: Foreign direct investment shapes growth, employment and capital inflows in emerging European economies such as Romania.

n8b7abeedda.summary: ZF describes the Romanian banking system as robust, resilient and well capitalised, with banks recovering quickly and posting historic highs on several fronts in recent years.

nfcfbd8400d.summary: The tax-free limit for customer bonuses received through electronic payments rises from €300 a month to €6,000 a year. The change was announced by the Greek government.
